china_race_dynamics.text: Had a great discussion on AI this week with the Madison County Business League & Foundation and Madison County Economic Development Authority. AI offers real opportunities for Mississippi’s farmers, manufacturers, and small businesses, but we must protect privacy, strengthen cybersecurity, and ensure America leads this technology – not China.

china_race_dynamics.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has received quite a lot of attention lately, and I'm proud to see it.
